Is this player still obligated to getting punished for excessive infractions? They did appeal a "Ban for Excessive Infractions" but right after the appealed ban, he was punished 3-4 more times, just wondering if they can get temp banned/banned since they are receiving infractions after an appealed ban, usually consists of promising not to break any rules when appealing this type of ban (Excessive Infractions)
